claims: For the 2026 Masters, ticket prices directly from Augusta National were $125–$150 for practice rounds.
For the 2026 Masters, ticket prices directly from Augusta National were $160 for daily tournament rounds.
Four-day badges for the 2026 Masters cost $525.
Official ticket prices for the 2026 Masters are the lowest official prices for any major.
Tickets for the 2026 Masters are only available via an official lottery.
Practice Rounds (Monday/Tuesday) ticket price for the 2026 Masters is $125.
Practice Round (Wednesday/Par 3) ticket price for the 2026 Masters is $150.
Tournament Days (Thursday–Sunday) ticket price for the 2026 Masters is $160 per day.
Four-Day Tournament Badge price for the 2026 Masters is $525.
The only way to secure tickets at face value is through the official Masters Ticket Lottery.
Applications for the 2027 Masters open on June 1, 2026.
Masters tickets can be canceled if they are caught being sold.
Canceled Masters tickets lead to potential denial of entry.
Concession items at the Masters typically cost between $1.50 and $6.
